newsitem.title: USA: Thermal receives rival bid of $19/shr.
newsitem.headline: Thermal receives rival bid of $19/shr.

text.p: Thermal Industries Inc said Monday it has received an unsolicited offer from Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc dated March 27, to offer $19 per share, cash for all outstanding shares of Thermal.
The company said Hicks Muse requested a response from its board of directors by April 2.
Thermal said it is already in a merger agreement dated January 6 with H.I.G. Investment Group LP under which its shareholders will receive $15 per share in cash.

Thermal said its principal shareholders, who own more than 50 percent of Thermal's common stock, have informed it that they intend to vote for the HIG Merger and will not vote in favor of the Hicks Muse proposal because they believe that HIG would represent a better strategic fit for Thermal.

Thermal said it will take no action with respect to the Hicks Muse Proposal, and has called a special shareholders meeting for May 13, to vote on the HIG Merger, setting April 18, as the record date for the meeting.

The company also said that the HIG Merger agreement contains provisions which obligate Thermal to pay to HIG $5 million and reimburse its expenses up to $500,000 in the event that the HIG Merger is not consummated due to a third party acquisition proposal.
